response.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS m FROM pairs), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.m AS above FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.pair_avg > o.m), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(above) AS avg_above_mean FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_anlycount, avg_above_mean, avg_anlycount / AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS relative_to_type_mean FROM per_type

assumptions.assumption: A snapshot 'matches its transaction' when sentimentandfundamentals.transref equals an existing transactionrecord.transreg (inner join). Snapshots with no trdref2 or no matching trader are dropped.
The overall mean is the unweighted mean of the pair averages across all (transref, trader type) pairs. Pairs whose anlycount is entirely null have a null average and are excluded from it.
The final ratio divides each trader type's average analyst count by the unweighted mean of those per-type averages. Only trader types that have at least one kept pair appear in the output.
